name: 有效 K 个不同元素子数组 II
hints: For every left endpoint l, use two sliding windows to find the earliest right endpoint containing at least k distinct numbers and the earliest right endpoint containing at least k + 1 distinct numbers. This lets you determine in O(1) whether a query contains exactly k distinct numbers.

Assign each distinct value a random bitmask and build prefix XORs. The XOR over a subarray is zero when every value occurs an even number of times, with overwhelming probability. After preprocessing, each generated query can therefore be answered in O(1).
